summary: Built loader-diag-xnu-sc3-md1 for NAT-113 from NAT-110's chain: the loader sends a PX report (panel memory 0xfa200000 1080x2340: non-black count, FNV-1a, 108x234 RGB332 thumbnail) and a PR report (kernel screen recording, RWREC003 header and per-frame stats, range-checked against the NAT-111 XNU window) at the kernel's own return before the KL dump; cmdline adds rec_secs=30 rec_mb=64, drops keepsyms=1, no fb_diff, loader_return_after=63 (247 B). 24 host tests pass; 22/22 mutants killed; the session driver is session_nat110.py with 10 counted substitutions and refuses before any device access without a decision file. Nothing ran on a phone.
corrections: 120 s kernel window rejected: this loader's S5E9945 watchdog (83 s, guard.c) is petted for the last time before the jump (nat074_final_pet) and nothing feeds it afterwards; the 'paused WDT' claim came from references/hakios-scion-full (Galaxy S9 loader).
A full recording cannot be returned: the only return channel is EP0 TEXT, measured in NAT-111 at about 3.2 KB/s (380 KB of KL records in 117 s); hence statistics and a thumbnail.
serial=3 kept: kprintf reaches loader_log through serial_putc_crlf (redwood.patch, pexpert/arm/pe_kprintf.c).
